name: Yae Miko
notes: KQM and Game8 agree on Skill > Burst > Normal Attack, Kagura's Verity first and the same weapon pool (A Thousand Floating Dreams, Skyward Atlas, The Widsith, Flowing Purity), an ATK% or EM Sands, a CRIT Circlet, and on the sets by team: 4pc Disenchantment in Deep Shadow for Stellar-Conduct (Gilded Dreams second, with Heart of the Furnace KQM) and 4pc Golden Troupe otherwise (Gilded Dreams second; Game8 adds Gladiator's Finale; KQM adds Unfinished Reverie, Silken Moon's Serenade and Night of the Sky's Unveiling for Lunar-Charged). The Goblet is ATK% for Stellar-Conduct and Electro DMG otherwise (KQM allows EM). Sesshou Sakura (60.7% to 109.2% at level 1 and 10 for Level 1, elemental curve) is the damage, and her EM passive raises it. Goals are Game8's: ATK 2,000 or more, CR 60-70, CD 175 or above, EM 100-200 (upper ends); ER is Game8's 130-140 with a second Electro unit (160 or more solo, which it does not recommend), and KQM's 140-150 with Raiden at C0 (100 from C1). Partners are inferred (Dendro for Aggravate, Pyro for Overloaded, Anemo for Stellar-Conduct).
